notes.title: 1.0.18 Linux Support and Small Fixes
notes.content:
Changelist:
[list]
[*]New platform added: Linux. Tested on Ubuntu 20.
[*]New [Experimental] Control mode called "auto drag". With this you no longer have to click and drag.
[*]Spacebar will now rotate Tetrominos. Works for both control modes.
[*]Better support for monitors with varied refresh rates.
[/list]

notes.title: Progress towards Release
notes.content:
To make Kavel all it can be on PC and MAC, a lot of extra work and design has been done.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39064531/cd2ac7adb5c204fb4b329121781f15c940ead393.gif[/img]

[list]
[*]Settings menu changes
[*]New background effects to take advantage of the big screens
[*]Ultrawide monitor support
[*]Custom Highscore UI
[*]Save system changes
[*]Many, many small improvements
[/list]

Now that all this work has been done or is near completion I'm working on giving the Steam store page a bit of an upgrade. Getting everything ready for a successful launch.

Not to speak of a new game mode that's still in development.

So, I'm not confident enough to announce a real release date quite yet. For that I want to 100% know I can release at that date. I am however very close to that point. It's coming.

If you're reading this because you've wishlisted the game - Thanks!

Cheers,
Jerry
